commentary: Today, the DCE  iron ore futures surged signiﬁcantly, with the most-traded contract I2509 closing at 727.5, up 2.11% for the day. US President Trump spoke publicly on Tuesday, April 22, acknowledging that the current tariﬀs on Chinese exports to the US are too high and are expected to be signiﬁcantly reduced. This marks a soŌening of Trump's stance on his signature tariﬀ policy. Market senƟment was opƟmisƟc, driving a signiﬁcant rise in the futures market.
